title: Otto Warmbier: The American Tourist Who Never Came Home (English Listening Practice)
speaker: Alastair Budge

sentences.en: Hello, hello, hello, and welcome to English Learning for Curious Minds, by Leonardo English, the show where you can listen to fascinating stories and learn weird and wonderful things about the world at the same time as improving your English.
sentences.zh: 大家好，大家好，欢迎收听 Leonardo English 出品的 English Learning for Curious Minds。在这档节目里，你可以一边听引人入胜的故事，一边了解这个世界稀奇古怪、妙趣横生的知识，同时提升你的英语水平。

sentences.en: I'm Alastair Budge, and today it’s the start of another three-part mini-series, this time on the theme of “stories from North Korea”.
sentences.zh: 我是 Alastair Budge，今天我们将开启又一个三集迷你系列，这次的主题是"来自朝鲜的故事"。

sentences.en: In part one, this episode, we’ll be talking about Otto Warmbier, the 21-year-old American student who went on a trip to North Korea and returned unrecognisable.
sentences.zh: 在第一集，也就是今天这一期里，我们要讲的是奥托·瓦姆比尔(Otto Warmbier)——那位21岁的美国学生，他去朝鲜旅行，回来时却已经面目全非。

sentences.en: In part two, we’ll talk about the daylight murder of Kim Jong-un’s brother in Kuala Lumpur airport.
sentences.zh: 在第二集，我们会讲金正恩(Kim Jong-un)的哥哥在吉隆坡机场光天化日之下被杀的事件。

sentences.en: And in the final part, part three, we’ll talk about Kim Jong-il’s obsession with cinema, and how this led him to kidnap one of South Korea’s most famous directors.
sentences.zh: 而在最后一集，也就是第三集，我们会讲金正日(Kim Jong-il)对电影的痴迷，以及这份痴迷如何让他绑架了韩国最著名的导演之一。

sentences.en: OK then, let's not waste a minute and get right into it.
sentences.zh: 好了，那我们废话不多说，直接开始吧。

sentences.en: I can imagine you can all think of something that you regret doing when you were young.
sentences.zh: 我猜你们每个人都能想起一件年轻时做过、后来后悔的事。

sentences.en: From that tattoo you now try to cover up to betting your friend you could climb up a large tree, only to fall down and break your elbow, making mistakes and learning from them is all a part of growing up.
sentences.zh: 从你现在想方设法遮起来的纹身，到跟朋友打赌说自己能爬上一棵大树、结果摔下来摔断了手肘——犯错并从中吸取教训，本来就是成长的一部分。

sentences.en: And a holiday, far away from home, is the kind of place where mistakes are perhaps more likely to happen.
sentences.zh: 而远离家乡的旅行，恰恰是更容易出错的场合。

sentences.en: Normally, of course, mistakes aren’t permanent.
sentences.zh: 当然，通常来说，犯错不会造成永久性的后果。

sentences.en: A sore head in the morning, perhaps a slap on the wrist from a police officer for doing something more serious, but nothing that will forever change the trajectory of your life.
sentences.zh: 顶多是第二天早上头疼，或者因为做了更出格的事挨警察训一顿，但不会有什么能彻底改变你人生轨迹的事。

sentences.en: That is, unless the mistake takes place in North Korea.
sentences.zh: 除非，这个错误发生在朝鲜。

sentences.en: So, let me paint you a picture. It is the 2nd of January, 2016.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我给你们描绘一个场景。时间是2016年1月2日。

sentences.en: A young man is standing in Pyongyang International Airport, waiting to board a flight back to Beijing.
sentences.zh: 一个年轻人站在平壤国际机场，等着登上飞回北京的航班。

sentences.en: His name is Otto Warmbier. He is twenty-one years old, a star student at the University of Virginia, a dutiful son, and the eldest of three children.
sentences.zh: 他叫奥托·瓦姆比尔。他21岁，是弗吉尼亚大学的优等生，一个孝顺的儿子，家中三个孩子里的老大。

sentences.en: He has just spent five days in North Korea as part of a tour group, a $1,200 five-day, four-night “New Year's Party Tour”.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚跟团在朝鲜待了五天，参加的是一个1200美元、五天四晚的"新年派对之旅"。

sentences.en: Tourists are allowed in North Korea, or at least, back then they were, but only as part of a group, and under very tight supervision.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜是允许游客入境的，至少当时是这样，但只能跟团，而且要接受非常严密的监管。

sentences.en: He has seen what all tourists see: the vast bronze statues of the Kim family, the immaculate streets, the carefully choreographed displays of loyalty and order.
sentences.zh: 他看到了所有游客都会看到的东西：金氏家族巨大的青铜雕像、一尘不染的街道，还有精心编排的、展现忠诚与秩序的场面。

sentences.en: He has bowed where he was told to bow, photographed what he was allowed to photograph, and said nothing that might cause offence.
sentences.zh: 该鞠躬的地方他都鞠了躬，只拍了被允许拍的照片，也没说任何可能冒犯到谁的话。

sentences.en: It’s been fun. Eye-opening. A world away from his hometown of Cincinnati, Ohio, obviously.
sentences.zh: 这趟旅程很有趣，也很开眼界，和他的家乡——俄亥俄州辛辛那提——简直是两个世界，这是不言而喻的。

sentences.en: But now he is ready to leave. He is one of the last to go through security, and as he hands over his passport, the officers spend more time looking at his documents than seems necessary.
sentences.zh: 但现在他准备离开了。他是最后几个过安检的人之一，当他递上护照时，工作人员花在查看他证件上的时间比看起来该花的要长。

sentences.en: They flick through the pages, whispering to each other.
sentences.zh: 他们翻着护照的页面，彼此低声交谈。

sentences.en: Some more officials approach from behind, tap him on the shoulder, and ask him to follow them to a private room.
sentences.zh: 又有几名官员从后面走过来，拍了拍他的肩膀，要他跟他们去一个单独的房间。

sentences.en: The man he has been sharing a room with for the past few days, an Englishman named Danny Gratton, attempts a joke, telling Otto, “'Well, that's the last we'll see of you.”
sentences.zh: 过去几天一直和他同住一个房间的英国人丹尼·格拉顿(Danny Gratton)开了个玩笑，对奥托说："好吧，这大概是我们最后一次见到你了。"

sentences.en: Unfortunately, it would prove to be true.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这句话后来一语成谶。

sentences.en: This will be the last time anyone outside North Korea will see Otto Warmbier, at least, as the Otto Warmbier they knew.
sentences.zh: 这将是朝鲜境外的人最后一次见到奥托·瓦姆比尔——至少是他们所认识的那个奥托·瓦姆比尔。

sentences.en: Now, to understand what happened next, and perhaps why, we need to remind ourselves of a little bit of North Korean history.
sentences.zh: 现在，要理解接下来发生了什么，以及可能的原因，我们需要先回顾一点朝鲜的历史。

sentences.en: North Korea, or to give it its official name, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, is, by almost any measure, the most closed and controlled state in the world.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜，或者用它的正式名称——朝鲜民主主义人民共和国——几乎从任何角度衡量，都是世界上最封闭、管控最严的国家。

sentences.en: It has been ruled by the same family since 1948: first Kim Il-sung, then his son Kim Jong-il, and now his grandson Kim Jong-un.
sentences.zh: 自1948年以来，它一直由同一个家族统治：先是金日成(Kim Il-sung)，然后是他的儿子金正日，现在是他的孙子金正恩。

sentences.en: The regime maintains control through an almost total monopoly on information.
sentences.zh: 这个政权靠着对信息近乎完全的垄断来维持统治。

sentences.en: There is no free press, no independent internet access for ordinary citizens, and no meaningful political opposition.
sentences.zh: 这里没有自由的新闻媒体，普通民众也无法独立接入互联网，更没有任何有实质意义的政治反对派。

sentences.en: Leaving the country without permission is illegal and, for most people, essentially impossible.
sentences.zh: 未经许可离开国家是违法的，而且对大多数人来说，基本上也不可能做到。

sentences.en: For those who break the rules, or who are simply accused of doing so, the consequences can be devastating.
sentences.zh: 对于那些违反规定的人，或者仅仅是被指控违规的人来说，后果都可能是毁灭性的。

sentences.en: Sentences are extremely harsh, and typically involve back-breaking forced labour in the country’s network of political prison camps.
sentences.zh: 量刑极为严厉，通常意味着要在这个国家遍布各地的政治劳改营里，从事累断脊背的强制劳动。

sentences.en: And crucially for our story, North Korea is extraordinarily sensitive about its image.
sentences.zh: 而对我们这个故事来说至关重要的一点是，朝鲜对自己的形象极度敏感。

sentences.en: Any perceived insult to the leadership of the Kim family, to the state, to the symbols of the regime, these are treated not as a minor offence, but as a serious political crime.
sentences.zh: 任何被认为是对金氏家族领导层、对国家、对政权象征的冒犯，都不会被当作轻微违规处理，而会被视为严重的政治罪行。

sentences.en: And this brings us back to Otto Warmbier, and what the North Korean authorities said he had done.
sentences.zh: 这就把我们带回到奥托·瓦姆比尔身上，以及朝鲜当局所说的他所做的事。

sentences.en: For the first six weeks after his arrest, the only statement they released about him was that he had committed "a hostile act against the state".
sentences.zh: 在他被捕后的头六周里，朝鲜官方就他发布的唯一一份声明，是说他犯下了"敌视国家的行为"。

sentences.en: To Otto’s family, and to those who had been on the tour with him, this seemed… implausible, very unlikely.
sentences.zh: 对奥托的家人，以及和他一起参加旅行团的人来说，这听起来……难以置信，非常不可能。

sentences.en: He was a young man, an otherwise well-behaved, upstanding member of society.
sentences.zh: 他是个年轻人，平时行为端正，是社会上正派的一员。

sentences.en: He had been very cautious on the tour, and he knew all too well the consequences of getting on the wrong side of the regime.
sentences.zh: 他在旅途中一直非常谨慎，而且他很清楚，一旦得罪了这个政权会有什么后果。

sentences.en: Sure, it was New Year’s Eve, and everyone had had a few drinks, but there was no indication that he was particularly drunk or disorderly, nobody remembered him causing any problems.
sentences.zh: 没错，那天是除夕夜，大家都喝了点酒，但没有迹象表明他特别醉或者行为失控，也没有人记得他惹出过什么麻烦。

sentences.en: There must surely have been a mixup, a misunderstanding, and he would be released soon.
sentences.zh: 这里面肯定是搞错了，是个误会，他很快就会被放出来。

sentences.en: But…he wasn’t. On the 29th of February, 2016 — two months after his arrest — he was brought before the cameras for a press conference.
sentences.zh: 但……他没有被放出来。2016年2月29日——也就是他被捕两个月后——他被带到镜头前召开了一场记者会。

sentences.en: He appeared thin and clearly distressed.
sentences.zh: 他看起来很消瘦，明显十分痛苦。

sentences.en: In a halting, tearful voice, he delivered a prepared statement confessing to his alleged crimes and begging the North Korean government for forgiveness.
sentences.zh: 他用断断续续、带着哭腔的声音，宣读了一份事先准备好的声明，承认了他被指控的罪行，并恳求朝鲜政府的原谅。

sentences.en: "I have made the worst mistake of my life," the young man said, almost weeping.
sentences.zh: "我犯下了此生最严重的错误，"这个年轻人几乎带着哭腔说道。

sentences.en: You can see the entire thing on YouTube, and it is pretty painful to watch.
sentences.zh: 你可以在YouTube上看到整段录像，看起来相当令人痛心。

sentences.en: His family and the US government made clear that they considered the confession to have been made under duress — in other words, that he had been forced to say it.
sentences.zh: 他的家人和美国政府明确表示，他们认为这份供词是在胁迫之下做出的——换句话说，他是被逼说出这些话的。

sentences.en: They simply didn’t accept it. Even disregarding the content of the confession, and with our “English learner’s” hat on, the language was as if it had been written by a non-native speaker.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不接受这份供词。就算撇开供词的内容不谈，戴上我们"英语学习者"的帽子来看，这段话的用词读起来就像是出自一个非母语者之手。

sentences.en: He said things like, “I came to commit this crime task”, and “but since my family suffered from very severe financial difficulties”.
sentences.zh: 他说了这样的话："我是来完成这项犯罪任务的"，还有"但由于我的家庭遭受了非常严重的经济困难"。

sentences.en: This might be grammatically correct English, but these are not the words of a native English speaker.
sentences.zh: 这些句子在语法上或许没有错，但绝不是母语者会说的话。

sentences.en: Anyone listening to the speech could clearly understand that these weren’t his words; someone with good but imperfect English had drafted the statement.
sentences.zh: 任何听过这段发言的人都能清楚地看出，这些不是他自己的话；这份声明是由一个英语水平不错、但并非完美的人起草的。

sentences.en: The North Koreans’ claim was this: in the early hours of New Year’s Eve, Otto Warmbier had entered a staff-only area of his hotel and attempted to steal a political banner from a wall.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜方面的说法是：在除夕夜凌晨，奥托·瓦姆比尔进入了酒店的员工专用区域，试图从墙上偷走一条政治标语横幅。

sentences.en: Now, you might think, “ok, he had a few drinks and wanted to take a fun memento of his trip.
sentences.zh: 你可能会想，"好吧，他喝了点酒，想带走一件有趣的旅行纪念品。

sentences.en: He’s a young man, that’s not such a terrible crime”.
sentences.zh: 他还是个年轻人，这也不算什么大不了的罪行"。

sentences.en: Well, three things. Firstly, removing any kind of political banner in North Korea is a serious crime, no matter the intention.
sentences.zh: 但有三点要说。首先，在朝鲜，无论出于什么动机，取走任何政治标语横幅都是严重罪行。

sentences.en: You might think this law is extreme, but it is the law, and a North Korean citizen would certainly have been treated the same way, if not more harshly.
sentences.zh: 你可能觉得这条法律太极端，但它就是法律，而且一个朝鲜公民要是做了同样的事，肯定也会受到同样的对待，甚至更严厉。

sentences.en: Secondly, the supposed “evidence” for Otto taking the sign was flimsy at best.
sentences.zh: 其次，所谓证明奥托拿走标语的"证据"，说好听点也十分单薄。

sentences.en: There was some grainy CCTV footage that showed a tall-ish man touching the sign at around 1am, but, his companions on the trip said that they didn’t get back until more like 3am, and what’s more, this corridor was well-lit even in the middle of the night, which is very unusual in North Korea.
sentences.zh: 有一段模糊的监控录像，显示一个身材偏高的男子在凌晨一点左右碰了那条标语，但和他同行的旅伴说，他们其实是凌晨三点左右才回到酒店的，而且这条走廊即便在深夜也灯火通明，这在朝鲜是很不寻常的。

sentences.en: In other words, this CCTV footage was not exactly reliable.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这段监控录像并不算多可靠。

sentences.en: And lastly, and perhaps most bizarrely, the North Koreans claimed that Otto Warmbier’s actions were not those of a tipsy young American looking for something fun to hang in his dormroom; this was a hostile act, carried out at the instigation of a Methodist church group and the US government, as part of a deliberate attempt to destabilise the country.
sentences.zh: 最后，也是最离奇的一点：朝鲜方面声称，奥托·瓦姆比尔的行为根本不是一个微醺的美国年轻人想找点有趣的东西挂在宿舍墙上那么简单；这是一次敌对行动，是在一个卫理公会教会团体和美国政府的教唆下实施的，是蓄意颠覆国家行动的一部分。

sentences.en: Or at least, that was the official policy line, and what Otto confessed to in his prepared statement.
sentences.zh: 至少，这是官方的口径，也是奥托在那份事先准备好的声明中所"承认"的内容。

sentences.en: Now, that version of events was, to put it gently, implausible.
sentences.zh: 说得委婉一点，这个版本的说法实在难以令人信服。

sentences.en: Firstly, Otto Warmbier was Jewish, so he was unlikely to be part of a Methodist church.
sentences.zh: 首先，奥托·瓦姆比尔是犹太人，他不太可能是卫理公会教会的一员。

sentences.en: And secondly, he was a twenty-one-year-old student on a five-day group tour; the idea that he was a covert agent working with the CIA to bring down the North Korean government is not one that many Western observers found convincing.
sentences.zh: 其次，他只是一个参加五天跟团游的21岁学生；说他是与中情局(CIA)勾结、企图颠覆朝鲜政府的秘密特工，这种说法并没能说服多少西方观察人士。

sentences.en: But…it didn’t matter. North Korea was not interested in convincing anyone, anyone outside its borders, that was.
sentences.zh: 但……这些都不重要。朝鲜根本无意说服任何人——至少不打算说服国境之外的任何人。

sentences.en: It had Otto Warmbier, and there was nothing anyone else could do.
sentences.zh: 他们抓住了奥托·瓦姆比尔，其他任何人都无能为力。

sentences.en: A month later, at a trial that lasted barely an hour, he was found guilty and sentenced to fifteen years of hard labour.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，在一场仅持续了不到一小时的审判中，他被判有罪，处以15年劳役。

sentences.en: And then, from the perspective of the outside world, he disappeared.
sentences.zh: 然后，在外界眼中，他就此销声匿迹。

sentences.en: For the next seventeen months, his family received practically no information about his condition.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的17个月里，他的家人几乎得不到任何关于他状况的信息。

sentences.en: The North Korean government said he was being treated well and receiving medical care.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜政府说他受到了良好的对待，也得到了医疗照顾。

sentences.en: Now, there’s another aspect to this story.
sentences.zh: 这个故事还有另外一面。

sentences.en: The United States has never had formal diplomatic relations with North Korea, and the two countries are still technically at war.
sentences.zh: 美国从未与朝鲜建立过正式外交关系，严格来说，两国至今仍处于战争状态。

sentences.en: So actually having these conversations was…complicated.
sentences.zh: 所以要真正展开这些沟通，其实……相当复杂。

sentences.en: All communication went through Sweden, which does have an embassy, and staff in Pyongyang, the capital.
sentences.zh: 所有沟通都要经由瑞典进行，因为瑞典在朝鲜首都平壤设有大使馆和工作人员。

sentences.en: Otto’s parents, Fred and Cindy Warmbier, spoke publicly, pleading for their son's release, and trying everything they could think of to bring him home.
sentences.zh: 奥托的父母弗雷德(Fred)和辛迪·瓦姆比尔(Cindy Warmbier)公开发声，恳求释放他们的儿子，想尽一切办法要把他带回家。

sentences.en: And then, in June 2017, a year and a half after the incident, the North Korean government made a surprise announcement.
sentences.zh: 然后，在2017年6月，也就是事发一年半之后，朝鲜政府突然发布了一项声明。

sentences.en: Otto Warmbier would be released on humanitarian grounds.
sentences.zh: 奥托·瓦姆比尔将以人道主义理由获释。

sentences.en: He was, they said, in a coma, and had been since shortly after his trial in March 2016.
sentences.zh: 他们说，他一直处于昏迷状态，而且从2016年3月审判结束后不久就已经如此。

sentences.en: More than a year earlier. The reason they gave for the coma was something called botulism, which is a rare form of food poisoning, and they said that this, combined with a sleeping pill he had been given, had sent him into a coma.
sentences.zh: 那已经是一年多以前的事了。他们给出的昏迷原因，是一种叫肉毒中毒的罕见食物中毒，他们说这种病症再加上给他服用的一片安眠药，让他陷入了昏迷。

sentences.en: Now, we’ll come to whether this was actually true later on, but, spoiler alert, most foreign doctors don’t buy this official explanation.
sentences.zh: 这个说法是否属实，我们稍后再谈，不过先剧透一下：大多数外国医生并不相信这套官方解释。

sentences.en: On the 13th of June, Otto Warmbier arrived back in the United States.
sentences.zh: 6月13日，奥托·瓦姆比尔回到了美国。

sentences.en: His parents rushed to meet him, but as they approached the aeroplane, they heard this raw, almost animalistic groaning, like a primordial cry for help.
sentences.zh: 他的父母赶去接他，但当他们靠近飞机时，听到的是一阵原始而近乎野兽般的呻吟声，像是一种最本能的求救呼喊。

sentences.en: It was coming from Otto. He was a shadow of his former self.
sentences.zh: 那声音正是来自奥托。他已经不再是原来的样子，只剩一个影子般的躯壳。

sentences.en: His hair had been shaved off, he was hooked up with tubes, he was blind and deaf.
sentences.zh: 他的头发被剃光了，身上插满了各种管子，双目失明，双耳失聪。

sentences.en: He could not speak or respond to commands.
sentences.zh: 他既不能说话，也无法对指令做出反应。

sentences.en: He showed no signs of awareness of the world around him.
sentences.zh: 他没有表现出任何对周围世界的知觉。

sentences.en: He was rushed to hospital, where the doctors said he was in what’s called a state of unresponsive wakefulness, which is a condition where a person's eyes may open and they may breathe without assistance, but where there is no meaningful conscious activity.
sentences.zh: 他被紧急送往医院，医生说他处于所谓的"无反应觉醒状态"，在这种状态下，病人的眼睛可能会睁开，也能够自主呼吸，但不存在任何有意义的意识活动。

sentences.en: In other words, he had lost virtually all of his brain function.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他几乎丧失了全部脑功能。

sentences.en: And tragically, the doctors told his parents, it would never come back.
sentences.zh: 更悲惨的是，医生告诉他的父母，这种状况再也不会好转了。

sentences.en: There was no hope. His parents made the agonising decision to remove his feeding tube, thus sealing his fate.
sentences.zh: 已经没有希望了。他的父母痛苦地做出决定，撤掉他的喂食管，也因此为他的命运画上了句号。

sentences.en: Six days after his return home, on the 19th of June, 2017, Otto Warmbier died.
sentences.zh: 在他回国六天后,2017年6月19日，奥托·瓦姆比尔去世了。

sentences.en: He was twenty-two years old. His parents, who had spent seventeen months fighting to bring their son home, had him back for less than a week.
sentences.zh: 他去世时22岁。他的父母花了17个月努力把儿子带回家，而他们真正拥有他在身边的时间，却不到一周。

sentences.en: The question that followed, and which has still never been fully answered, was what happened to Otto Warmbier?
sentences.zh: 随之而来、至今也仍未彻底解答的问题是：奥托·瓦姆比尔身上到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: The North Korean government maintained that he had been treated well, that they bore no responsibility for his condition, and that his death was the result of the botulism, the food poisoning, that he had suffered before his coma.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜政府坚称他一直受到良好对待，他们对他的状况不负任何责任，他的死是由他昏迷前所患的肉毒中毒——也就是食物中毒——所导致的。

sentences.en: American doctors were deeply sceptical. If it was caused by botulism, it was unlike anything they had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 美国医生对此深表怀疑。如果这真是肉毒中毒引起的，那也和他们以往见过的任何病例都不一样。

sentences.en: As for his parents, they were, as any parent would be, desperate to find some kind of justice, to hold someone or something accountable for the death of their son.
sentences.zh: 至于他的父母，和任何为人父母者一样，他们迫切想讨回某种公道，想让某个人或某个机构为儿子的死负责。

sentences.en: By this point, there had been a change in the White House.
sentences.zh: 这时，白宫已经换了主人。

sentences.en: Barack Obama was out, and Donald Trump had taken his place at the start of 2017.
sentences.zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马(Barack Obama)已经卸任，唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)在2017年初接替了他的位置。

sentences.en: The Warmbiers knew that Donald Trump was a keen watcher of Fox News, and thought that if they could go on the show and tell their story, it might appeal to the one viewer who could do something about it: the then relatively recently inaugurated President Trump.
sentences.zh: 瓦姆比尔一家知道唐纳德·特朗普是福克斯新闻(Fox News)的忠实观众，他们觉得，如果能上那个节目讲述自己的遭遇，或许能打动那位唯一有能力采取行动的观众——那位刚刚上任不久的特朗普总统。

sentences.en: In these interviews, the Warmbiers stated that they believed their son had been tortured.
sentences.zh: 在这些采访中，瓦姆比尔夫妇表示，他们相信儿子曾遭受过酷刑。

sentences.en: Otto’s father stated that his son’s teeth looked like they had been rearranged with pliers, and that he had a scar on his foot.
sentences.zh: 奥托的父亲说，儿子的牙齿看起来像是被钳子重新排列过一样，脚上还有一道伤疤。

sentences.en: The Fox interview worked. It had its intended purpose.
sentences.zh: 这次福克斯的采访起了作用，达到了预期的目的。

sentences.en: Donald Trump tweeted out “great interview”, adding that “Otto was tortured beyond belief by North Korea”, despite there being no evidence that he actually was.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普发推特称这是"一次很棒的采访"，还补充说"奥托在朝鲜遭受了令人难以置信的酷刑"，尽管当时并没有证据表明他真的遭受过酷刑。

sentences.en: Now, the backdrop of all of this was the escalating war of words between Donald Trump and Kim Jong-un, after North Korea’s repeated nuclear weapons tests.
sentences.zh: 而这一切的大背景，是在朝鲜多次进行核试验之后，唐纳德·特朗普与金正恩之间不断升级的口水战。

sentences.en: Some commentators would later claim that the Otto Warmbier case was used by Trump to drum up anti-North Korean sentiment in preparation for a potential military strike.
sentences.zh: 后来有评论人士声称，特朗普利用了奥托·瓦姆比尔一案来煽动反朝鲜情绪，为一场可能的军事打击做铺垫。

sentences.en: Now, this strike never came, thankfully, but encouraging the idea that North Korea had tortured Otto Warmbier to death certainly helped reinforce this image of the regime as brutal and dangerous.
sentences.zh: 值得庆幸的是，这场打击最终没有发生，但极力渲染"朝鲜将奥托·瓦姆比尔折磨致死"这种说法，确实有助于强化这个政权残暴而危险的形象。

sentences.en: But, as you may remember, in 2018, there was an about turn.
sentences.zh: 但正如你可能记得的，到了2018年，情况出现了一百八十度大转弯。

sentences.en: After a series of meetings, Donald Trump declared that he and Kim had “fallen in love”, and the so-called “North Korea crisis” was over.
sentences.zh: 在一系列会晤之后，唐纳德·特朗普宣布他和金正恩已经"坠入爱河"，所谓的"朝鲜危机"也就此结束。

sentences.en: There was now no wider geopolitical incentive to push the kingdom over its treatment of Otto Warmbier, and in 2019, Trump publicly stated that he thought Kim Jong-un didn’t know what had happened.
sentences.zh: 此时，在更大的地缘政治层面上，已经没有动力去追究这个国家在奥托·瓦姆比尔一事上的责任了，到了2019年，特朗普甚至公开表示，他认为金正恩并不知道当时发生了什么。

sentences.en: In other words, he, and the North Koreans, were off the hook.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，金正恩本人，还有整个朝鲜，都算是脱了身。

sentences.en: Nobody would see justice, at least publicly, for whatever happened to Otto Warmbier.
sentences.zh: 无论奥托·瓦姆比尔身上到底发生过什么，至少在公开层面上，没有人会为此讨回公道了。

sentences.en: So…what did happen, or at least what are some theories about what happened?
sentences.zh: 那么……究竟发生了什么，或者说，关于发生了什么，又有哪些猜测呢？

sentences.en: In terms of whether he even removed the propaganda poster, the evidence is inconclusive.
sentences.zh: 就他到底有没有取走那张宣传海报这一点而言，证据其实并不确凿。

sentences.en: Maybe he did, after a few too many beers.
sentences.zh: 也许他确实这么做了，是在喝了太多啤酒之后。

sentences.en: Or it wasn’t him at all; the North Korean authorities thought it would be politically useful to have an American captive, and he was simply unlucky.
sentences.zh: 又或者根本不是他干的；朝鲜当局只是觉得扣押一名美国人在政治上有用，而他只是运气不好。

sentences.en: And how did he end up in a coma? The official North Korean verdict, according to American doctors, is unlikely.
sentences.zh: 那么他又是怎么陷入昏迷的呢？按照美国医生的看法，朝鲜官方给出的说法不太可能属实。

sentences.en: But so is his parents’ claim that he was badly beaten.
sentences.zh: 但他父母所说的他曾遭受严重殴打这一说法，同样也不太可能。

sentences.en: His body didn’t show signs of torture, American prisoners in North Korea are generally not tortured, and it was far more politically useful for North Korea to have him alive and healthy than in a vegetative state.
sentences.zh: 他的身体上没有酷刑的痕迹，在朝鲜被关押的美国人通常也不会遭受酷刑，而且对朝鲜来说，让他活着且健康，远比让他变成植物人在政治上更有用。

sentences.en: In other words, why would he have been tortured?
sentences.zh: 换句话说，朝鲜为什么要折磨他呢？

sentences.en: Nobody stood to gain from it. The American doctors stated that his brain damage, and subsequent coma, were most likely caused by oxygen deprivation, when your brain doesn’t get enough oxygen.
sentences.zh: 没有人能从中得到什么好处。美国医生表示，他的脑损伤以及随后的昏迷，最有可能是由缺氧引起的，也就是大脑得不到足够的氧气。

sentences.en: This can be caused by physical violence, but it can also be caused by many other things: cardiac arrest, suffocation, drowning and so on.
sentences.zh: 这种情况可能由暴力造成，但也可能由许多其他原因引起：心脏骤停、窒息、溺水等等。

sentences.en: To be fair, the American doctors said that Otto had otherwise been kept in good condition, and well looked after.
sentences.zh: 平心而论，美国医生表示，除此之外，奥托的身体状况保持得还不错，也得到了良好的照料。

sentences.en: But whatever had happened, he left North Korea a shell of the person who had arrived seventeen months earlier.
sentences.zh: 但无论发生了什么，他离开朝鲜时，已经只是17个月前那个抵达朝鲜的人的一具空壳。

sentences.en: There are a few theories about what might have happened.
sentences.zh: 关于当时可能发生了什么，有几种猜测。

sentences.en: One is that it was some kind of tragic accident, either a genuine accident or some miscalculation by one of the guards.
sentences.zh: 一种猜测是，这是某种悲剧性的意外——要么是真正的事故，要么是某个看守的失误判断。

sentences.en: The North Koreans invented the botulism and sleeping pill excuse, thinking it might be more plausible than whatever did happen, but it had the opposite effect.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜方面编造出肉毒中毒和安眠药这个借口，以为这听起来会比实际发生的事更可信，但结果却适得其反。

sentences.en: Another theory was put forward in a GQ article, and this was that Otto Warmbier might have tried to kill himself shortly after hearing his sentence.
sentences.zh: 另一种说法出现在《GQ》杂志的一篇文章里，认为奥托·瓦姆比尔可能是在听到判决结果后不久，试图自杀。

sentences.en: 15 years in a labour camp. He was distraught, and might have tried to end his life before being found by his guards, but not before suffering such high levels of oxygen deprivation that he was sent into a coma.
sentences.zh: 15年的劳改。他当时极度绝望，或许在被看守发现之前就试图了结自己的生命，但在这过程中，他承受了严重的缺氧，最终陷入了昏迷。

sentences.en: The truth will almost certainly never see the light of day.
sentences.zh: 真相几乎肯定永远不会大白于天下。

sentences.en: Otto Warmbier was not a spy. He was not a dissident.
sentences.zh: 奥托·瓦姆比尔不是间谍，也不是异见人士。

sentences.en: He was a young man on holiday who, by any reasonable measure, did nothing that warranted the response it received.
sentences.zh: 他只是一个出门度假的年轻人，不管从哪个合理的角度衡量，他所做的事都不至于招致他所遭受的那种对待。

sentences.en: And he died for it. Fortunately for any young Americans who might be thinking about making a similar trip, promising their mothers that things are different now, and the same thing would never happen again, they can’t.
sentences.zh: 而他却为此付出了生命。对于任何还在考虑做类似旅行、向自己母亲保证"现在情况不一样了，同样的事绝不会再发生"的美国年轻人来说，幸运的是，他们已经没有这个机会了。

sentences.en: The US State Department imposed a travel ban on US citizens visiting North Korea shortly after Otto Warmbier’s death, and North Korea currently also has a ban on American citizens entering the country as tourists.
sentences.zh: 在奥托·瓦姆比尔去世后不久，美国国务院就对美国公民前往朝鲜实施了旅行禁令，而目前朝鲜也禁止美国公民以游客身份入境。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the story of Otto Warmbier does not have a tidy conclusion, in the sense that justice has not been served and accountability has not followed.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，奥托·瓦姆比尔的故事没有一个圆满的结局——公道没有得到伸张，也没有人为此承担责任。

sentences.en: Kim Jong-un remains in power. The regime continues.
sentences.zh: 金正恩依然大权在握，这个政权仍在继续。

sentences.en: The camps continue. But what Otto's case did was to make something vivid and undeniable that had previously been easy, for many people, to file away as abstract: North Korea is not merely strange or amusing or ideologically peculiar.
sentences.zh: 那些劳改营也仍在继续运转。但奥托的案子所起到的作用，是让一件事变得鲜活而不容否认——而在此之前，许多人很容易把这件事当作一种抽象的概念束之高阁：朝鲜不只是奇怪、好笑，或者意识形态上有些古怪而已。

sentences.en: A funny hermit kingdom ruled by a despot with an unconventional haircut.
sentences.zh: 它不只是一个由一个留着奇特发型的独裁者统治的、有点滑稽的隐士王国。

sentences.en: It can be genuinely, systematically, brutal.
sentences.zh: 它可以是真真切切、有组织、有体系的残暴。

sentences.en: And if your name is Otto Warmbier, fatal.
sentences.zh: 而如果你叫奥托·瓦姆比尔，这种残暴甚至可能是致命的。

sentences.en: OK, then, that is it for today's episode on Otto Warmbier.
sentences.zh: 好了，今天这期关于奥托·瓦姆比尔的节目就到这里。

sentences.en: As a reminder, this is part one of a three part mini-series.
sentences.zh: 提醒一下，这是三集迷你系列的第一集。

sentences.en: Next up we’ll be talking about the brazen daylight murder of Kim Jong-un’s brother, and in part three it’ll be Kim Jong-il’s peculiar love for cinema, and how that led him to kidnapping a famous South Korean director.
sentences.zh: 接下来我们会讲金正恩的哥哥在光天化日之下被公然杀害的事件，而在第三集里，我们会讲金正日对电影那份奇特的热爱，以及这份热爱如何让他绑架了一位著名的韩国导演。

sentences.en: You've been listening to English Learning for Curious Minds by Leonardo English.
sentences.zh: 以上就是 Leonardo English 出品的 English Learning for Curious Minds。

sentences.en: I'm Alastair Budge, you stay safe, and I'll catch you in the next episode.
sentences.zh: 我是 Alastair Budge，祝大家平安，我们下期节目再见。
